# Source-only; NOT_RUN. Routing of the server command for --dra-state. The
# server callback prints the route it was given and returns; it never calls
# Install, so no state directory is created by any case.

# Help lists the flags.
skygo-kubernetes server --help
stdout '--dra-state'
stdout '--dra-log-retention'
! stdout 'route'

# --dra-state requires --targets and --execution-state, before any file is read.
! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --dra-state $WORK/dra
stderr '--dra-state requires --targets and --execution-state'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'route'

! skygo-kubernetes server --namespace tasks --dra-state ''
stderr '--dra-state requires --targets and --execution-state'
! stdout 'route'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --dra-log-retention 1h
stderr '--dra-log-retention requires --dra-state'
! stderr 'absent'
! stdout 'route'

# Environment profiles still conflict with execution state.
! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/absent.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --dra-state $WORK/dra --environment-profiles $WORK/absent.yaml --auth-file auth.json
stderr '--execution-state conflicts with --environment-profiles'
! stdout 'route'

# A DRA accelerator without --dra-state is refused after the file is read and
# before the server runs: no target silently drops or reroutes it.
! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/dra.yaml
stderr 'dra accelerators require --dra-state'
! stdout 'route'

! skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/dra.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state
stderr 'dra accelerators require --dra-state'
! stdout 'route'

# The DRA route hands the server an Install and no Targets callback.
skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/dra.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state --dra-state $WORK/dra --dra-log-retention 24h
stdout 'install route'
! stdout 'targets route'

# Positive control: ordinary configuration keeps the Targets route unchanged,
# with or without execution state.
skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/plain.yaml
stdout 'targets route'
! stdout 'install route'

skygo-kubernetes server --targets $WORK/plain.yaml --execution-state $WORK/state
stdout 'targets route'

! exists $WORK/state
! exists $WORK/dra

-- dra.yaml --
version: 1
targets:
- name: gpu
  in_cluster: true
  namespace: skygo-dra
  resources:
    accelerators:
      h100:
        dra:
          device_class: gpu.example.com
-- plain.yaml --
version: 1
targets:
- name: plain
  in_cluster: true
  namespace: skygo
